implementation_summary: Root cause of the 4 EV-0006 failures: the wizard opens the report on RUN_COMPLETED (orchestrator.ts:1651), sent before checkup-run.ts finishes its post-run steps and sets phase 'done' (line 585). The default 1000 ms poll for 'done' ran out under full-suite load, so 'New check-up' failed. Past check-ups then read /api/runs before report.keep wrote the second summary ('(1 check-up)'). secondRunId stayed '' so Go deeper opened /reports/ (no button), and Settings' goBack landed on /reports/ instead of /check. Fix: assign secondRunId before the poll; 60 s deadline on the 'done' poll with a comment giving the reason; same 'done' wait added after the first run (new assertion). Running alone exposed a 5th failure at line 735: the expected screen sizes had been changed to all three in unrelated commit f7fdeed6, against the product contract (site-memory.ts:41, checkup-run.ts:665, checkups.test.ts:387; confirmed by DEC-010) and the test's own setup (Phone/Tablet switched off in the review). Restored the exact Set{'1440px'} and added an equality check against the first check-up's sizes. Fixed ports and BE-102/FE-191 were not causes.
